snippet.title: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE | Tokyo Game Show Trailer
snippet.description:
Tune in for a brand-new FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE trailer packed with latest looks at the story of vengeance and bonds in the first FINAL FANTASY in HD‑2D!

Coming to Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC and Steam on October 22, 2026.

Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

A free demo is available now on all platforms.
